fields.description: Use the FedEx sandbox environment (apis-sandbox.fedex.com) instead of production (apis.fedex.com).
fields.label: Use Sandbox

fields.description: API Key (client_id) issued by the FedEx Developer Portal for this project.
fields.label: Client ID (API Key)

fields.description: Secret Key (client_secret) issued alongside the Client ID. Used as a form field on the /oauth/token exchange -- never sent to any other endpoint.
fields.label: Client Secret

fields.description: Cached OAuth2 access token from the last successful client_credentials exchange. Read-only -- refreshed automatically before it expires (FedEx tokens are documented as 1-hour lived).
fields.label: Access Token (cached)

fields.description: Not read by any sync logic yet (shipment/label creation isn't built) -- placeholder for when it is. Not required so auth-only testing isn't blocked on ERPNext-side setup unrelated to FedEx.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: Default origin/ship-from warehouse for shipments created through this connector. Not read by any sync logic yet.
fields.label: Default Warehouse

fields.description: FedEx account number the shipments/rates are billed to. Required by the real Ship/Rate APIs (requestedShipment.shipper / accountNumber) once those are implemented -- not read yet.
fields.label: FedEx Account Number

fields.description: How often to automatically run the pull sync (external → Alaiy OS).
fields.label: Pull Sync Interval

fields.description: How often to automatically run the push sync (Alaiy OS → external).
fields.label: Push Sync Interval
